conventions.numbers: exact strings only: 'a' under tag Q, or [a, b] meaning a + b*sqrt(d) under tag Quad(d); reduced fractions, never decimals
conventions.rotation: each cell stores R row-major as [ux, vx, uy, vy]; the verifier checks R^T R = I and det R = 1
conventions.container: a square of side L with lower corner `origin`; a cell is inside iff origin <= centre - e and centre + e <= origin + L with e = (|ux| + |uy|)/2
conventions.sat: a pair is separated iff some axis q of either frame has |d.q| - (1/2 + ext_other(q)) >= 0; the witness is the axis with the largest slack, and >= 0 is accepted at clearance 0
conventions.first_failure: the verifier stops at the first exact failed inequality and names it, distinguishing `infeasible` from `outside_representation`

display_only.note: 12-dp decimal strings: a projection of the pose, never an input to an exact check
rounded for reading; every number there has an exact source
decimal shadows via Decimal at 12 dp; where a decision is reported the exact string is printed beside it
